data.floorNote: At a $25 floor all 11 ledger claims clear it. A further $84 across 6 sub-floor discrepancies is logged as measured leakage rather than filed — assembly costs more than the recovery.

policy.why: Below this, evidence assembly costs more than the claim returns. Sub-floor items are logged so leakage is still a number.
A claim files only when every document policy names for that type is attached. Partial submissions burn the window and the goodwill.
Filing is batched to keep case volume legible to the marketplace and to keep the analyst cost per claim near $8.
One appeal with new evidence. After that it is written off and recorded — a second appeal on the same facts is noise.
No claim is filed on a fee we cannot tie to the marketplace’s own record. Volume is not the metric; recovery rate is.

windows.starts: from the date the fee was charged
from the adjustment date, after the 30-day auto-match
from the refund, once the return window elapses

candidacy.label: The inputs are their records
candidacy.detail: Fee tables, measured dimensions, adjustment logs and refund events all come from the marketplace. Realify is reconciling, not estimating.

candidacy.label: The test is deterministic
candidacy.detail: A claim either matches a published window with the named evidence or it does not. There is no elasticity, no forecast, no judgment call.

candidacy.label: The downside is a denial
candidacy.detail: A wrong claim returns a polite no. Nothing repriced, no customer affected, no inventory committed — the cheapest possible way to be wrong.

locked.label: Filing windows are policy, not preference
locked.detail: Each window is read from the marketplace’s published claim policy and versioned. When a policy changes, the ledger re-sorts the same day.

locked.label: Evidence standards per claim type
locked.detail: Dimension claims need a measured-dimension record; lost-inventory claims need the shipment reconciliation; shortage claims need carrier proof of delivery.

locked.label: Recovered cash is attributed, not absorbed
locked.detail: Every recovery posts to the Cash lens with the claim reference attached, so the period total is auditable line by line.

trigger.what: The Fee Reconciliation Engine finished the monthly pass over 41,880 fee lines and found 17 discrepancies against the marketplace’s own measurements and adjustment logs.
Eleven cleared the $25 floor at $4,120 total. The remaining six, $84 together, were logged as measured leakage without being promoted to claims.
The Claim Evidence Assembler scored completeness per claim and sorted by deadline rather than value — $890 of the total closes within 21 days.
